title: workspace_kind.sh never classifies a workspace as ssot when python3 is absent
objective: Fix at its source the baseline integration failure tests/ops/scripts/test_pr_gate_pytest_workspace_scope.py::test_consumer_workspace_skips_the_governance_registry. ops/scripts/lib/workspace_kind.sh _workspace_kind_realpath shells out to python3; with no python3 on PATH both resolutions are empty, the comparison "" = "" holds, and classify_workspace_kind answers ssot for every workspace (fail-open: a consumer repository is treated as the governance SSOT). Replace the helper with shell builtins and refuse to equate two empty resolutions. The other baseline failures are out of scope: test_org_dotgithub single-reader was fixed by merged #814, and the three test_pr_gate_overlap_routing failures are ENVIRONMENT (the integration image lacks uv and the locked .venv that run_pr_gate.sh correctly fails closed on; CI and the host provide both).
success_criteria: classify_workspace_kind returns consumer for a non-governance directory when python3 is unavailable (PATH stub exiting 127), and still returns ssot for the SSOT and ssot_checkout for an identity tree (V1)
the new test_workspace_kind.sh case fails against the current helper and passes after the fix (V1, checkpoint C1)
tests/ops/scripts/test_pr_gate_pytest_workspace_scope.py passes inside the integration container image (l9-cg-deps:06fee41, PATH=/usr/bin:/bin, no python3 there) where it failed before (V3)
no consumer of classify_workspace_kind changes behaviour on a host that has python3 (V1, V2)

in: ops/scripts/lib/workspace_kind.sh: _workspace_kind_realpath and the ssot comparison in classify_workspace_kind
out: tests/ops/scripts/test_pr_gate_overlap_routing.py: ENVIRONMENT, the gate's locked-interpreter contract (ensure_gov_python.sh) is correct to fail closed without uv
integration image or Core toolchain changes (uv, wheel cache): would be new provisioning, excluded by the operator
ops/autonomy/resolve_execution_gate.py: Python mirror of the identity test, unaffected
any change to the test under repair (it encodes the correct contract)
